question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Permeate
solution:
The correct answer is option 4), i.e., 'Diffuse.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's look at the meanings of the given word and marked option:

 
 
• **Permeate** - to spread throughout. (फैलना, पूर्णतः भर देना)
 
• **Diffuse** - to spread or scatter widely. (विस्तार करना)
 
 
 
• ​Let's look at the meanings of the other given options:​
 
 
• **Exude** - to ooze out. (बह निकलना, टपकना)
 
• **Continue** - to keep going. (जारी रखना)
 
• **Remain** - to stay or be left in a particular state. (बने रहना, बचा हुआ)
 
 
 
• Clearly, the word 'Diffuse' is closest in meaning to the given word 'Permeate.'
 
• Therefore, the correct synonym of the given word is option 4.
